expectations.text: Offers short spark ideas rather than a prescriptive multi-beat plan
expectations.evidence: 5 sparks, each a short paragraph. No beat-by-beat sequence, no When/What happens/If ignored structure. Each spark is an independent entry point the DM can pick.

expectations.text: Proposes or sketches a soothsayer NPC concept with enough flavor to be useful
expectations.evidence: Entities Needed section describes: 'traveling bone-reader, female, hooded, currently in Ardenville for the festival. Unnamed to the party initially.' Enough to envision the NPC, defers full creation to dnd-npc-generator.

expectations.text: The soothsayer's hints reference specific vault events, not generic prophecy
expectations.evidence: Spark 2: 'cobblestones, smoke, two bodies that fell wrong' and 'The dead don't stay quiet when they were carrying something someone wants back.' Spark 5: references 'Martyr' name and 'cobblestones remember.' All tied to specific vault events.

expectations.text: Delegates entity creation to other skills rather than building NPCs/encounters inline
